title: NGS Prep Part 2/3: Library Quantification
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load tuberack with reagents
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack (4 × 6 insert for 2 ml Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes) in slot 2 of the deck. Fill tubes A1‑A5 with water and tube B1 with the QPCR mastermix.

steps.title: Configure pipette mount sides
steps.instruction: Enter the correct mount side for each GEN1 single‑channel electronic pipette (P10 and P300) in the Opentrons software.

steps.title: Obtain and load protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the QPCR plate‑set‑up protocol file and upload it into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the deck as shown in the deck map: the Eppendorf twin.tec 96‑well PCR plate (150 µL, catalog #0030128605) on the temperature module with the 96‑well aluminum block insert; the 10 µL and 200 µL filter tipracks; the 4‑in‑1 tuberack in slot 2; and any other required modules.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, perform calibration of the deck labware, tipracks, and both the P10 and P300 pipettes according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the Opentrons App to start the QPCR plate set‑up for library quantification.
